chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Your defect is concealed; how happy you are as long as your status/position is good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when your defects are concealed by your position?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) observes that high social status often masks personal defects, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia understanding of 'haya' (modesty/shyness) and social perception. The phrase 'how happy you are' highlights the blessing of a dignified position that conceals one's shortcomings from public view. This reflects the scholarly view that reputation serves as a protective veil, allowing individuals to function despite minor flaws.
